events.text: VP-72 was consolidated at Ebeye Island.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 8 June 1944 : VP-72 was consolidated at Ebeye Island

events.text: VP-72 was relieved by VP-18 for return to NAS Kaneohe Bay.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 17 July 1944 : VP-72 was relieved by VP-18

events.text: The squadron arrived at San Diego.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 1 August 1944 : The squadron arrived at San Diego
